mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq, c.post_seq AS postSeq, c.user_seq AS userSeq, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.user_name AS userName, CASE WHEN c.user_seq = #{loginUserSeq} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isOwner FROM communication_comment c JOIN member m ON m.user_seq = c.user_seq WHERE c.post_seq = #{postSeq} ORDER BY c.comment_seq DESC

SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq, c.post_seq AS postSeq, c.user_seq AS userSeq, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM communication_comment c WHERE c.comment_seq = #{commentSeq} AND c.user_seq = #{userSeq}

SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq, c.post_seq AS postSeq, c.user_seq AS userSeq, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM communication_comment c WHERE c.comment_seq = #{commentSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO communication_comment (post_seq, user_seq, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postSeq}, #{userSeq}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
